editorial.thesis: A trading-and-learning city of about 1.2 million. Its retail is heavy on pharmacy & health retail and apparel, footwear & jewellery, and thin on fitness & wellness and grocery & daily needs — and 28% of residents live in zones with under 60% of the city's average retail depth.
takeaways: Branded retail is about 62% of Ranchi's. 6.3 chain outlets per lakh residents against 10.1 in Ranchi; 26 of the 51 national brands we track are present, led by Domino's 8, Apollo Pharmacy 6, V-Mart 6.

The mapped economy leans to malls & department stores. Shares of all mapped places: malls & department stores 1.0% (Ranchi 0.7%); shops & retail 16.8% (Ranchi 14.8%); services & crafts 5.4% (Ranchi 7.3%); grocery & daily needs 1.3% (Ranchi 1.6%). Raw counts would mislead because Ranchi is mapped more completely (10,516 places against 3,343), so we compare mix, not counts.

Supply and demand are misaligned. 3 zones hold 28% of residents with under 60% of the city's average retail depth. Indian School Of Mines alone has about 142,000 residents and 14 mapped food & drink places.

Retail is more concentrated than in Ranchi. 56% of commercial places sit in the busiest tenth of the city (Ranchi 54%). The largest cores are Manaitand (730 places) and Centralized Delivery Office (316).

The widest brand gaps against Ranchi. Reliance Smart / Fresh 5 outlets vs 16; Bata 3 outlets vs 12; Titan 2 outlets vs 11. These are leads to check against live listings, not verdicts: a brand may trade under another name or have opened since the map was updated.

numbers.title: The city in eight numbers
numbers.deck: A 8 km circle around the centre, processed with the same rules as Ranchi, so every comparison is like for like. Where raw counts would mislead — because a bigger city is mapped more completely — we compare shares and mix instead.

map.title: Where people live, where shops are
map.deck: Switch layers. The amber “gap” layer is the one to study: it marks places with many residents but little retail around them. Hover any hexagon (about 0.1 km²) for its numbers; click a zone on the right to isolate it.

captions.residents: Where people live. Manaitand and Indian School Of Mines are the largest zones by residents (481,000 and 142,000). Modelled residents per square kilometre.
captions.supply: Where the shops are. The busiest tenth of cells hold 56% of all commercial places, and Manaitand alone lists 730.
captions.chains: Where the brands are. Manaitand holds 20 of the 73 tracked chain outlets, and Centralized Delivery Office adds 12.
captions.education: Where the campuses are. Manaitand and Indian School Of Mines lead on education places (109 and 49, with 49 and 10 coaching centres) — a daytime youth market that residents alone do not show.
captions.gap: The gap. Amber: many residents nearby, little retail. Blue: far more retail than local residents explain — the commercial cores that draw people in. The deepest amber sits in Indian School Of Mines and Bccl Township. The blue cores include Manaitand.

zones.title: Zone by zone, by PIN code
zones.deck: Each zone is a postal-code area. Residents are modelled counts; places are mapped businesses and services. “Retail depth” is places per 10,000 residents — the tick marks the city average. Click a row to see it on the map.

mix.title: What the retail layer is made of
mix.deck: Raw counts per resident would favour whichever city is mapped more completely (10,516 places in Ranchi against 3,343 here). So this compares each category's share of all mapped places. 100 means the same share as Ranchi; below 100 is thinner, above is stronger.
mix.note: Against Ranchi, Dhanbad's mapped places over-index on malls & department stores (1.0% vs 0.7%), shops & retail (16.8% vs 14.8%), education (14.0% vs 12.6%) and under-index on services & crafts (5.4% vs 7.3%), grocery & daily needs (1.3% vs 1.6%), offices (7.4% vs 9.3%).

chains.title: Who is mapped here, and who is not
chains.deck: 73 outlets of 26 tracked national brands within 8 km — 6.3 per lakh residents against Ranchi's 10.1 (167 outlets of 29 brands). Filled names have at least one mapped outlet (count shown); dashed names have none.
chains.note: Read dashed names as leads, not verdicts. “No mapped outlet” can mean a brand trades under a different listed name, or has opened since the map was updated. The widest gaps against Ranchi are Reliance Smart / Fresh (5 vs 16); Bata (3 vs 12); Titan (2 vs 11). Premium reports check every lead against live listings.

formats.title: Which formats have room
formats.deck: 9 formats, thinnest first. The index is the format's share of all mapped places relative to Ranchi's, so low means thin by Ranchi's standard. “Where to look” ranks zones with at least 40,000 residents by residents per mapped outlet — a first-pass screen for where one more outlet would face the least local competition.

people.title: Who the customers are
people.deck: Age mix inside the 8 km circle, from Meta's age rasters (modelled, not a census).
people.note: Dhanbad's age mix against Ranchi: children (0–14) 27.7% vs 27.2%, 15–24 20.5% vs 19.7%, working age 45.5% vs 45.7%, 60+ 6.2% vs 7.3%. Under-25s are 48% of residents.

zones.826001: Reasonably supplied: 730 places for about 481,000 residents (index 74), 20 chain outlets.
zones.826004: An under-served zone: about 142,000 residents, 149 mapped places, 14 food & drink and 7 chain outlets. Depth index 51.
zones.826007: A commercial core: 316 mapped places and 12 chain outlets (16% of the city's tracked chains) for about 82,000 residents. A destination zone, so much of its footfall likely lives elsewhere.
zones.826005: An under-served zone: about 52,000 residents, 45 mapped places, 1 food & drink and 0 chain outlets. Depth index 42.
zones.826008: An under-served zone: about 34,000 residents, 24 mapped places, 1 food & drink and 0 chain outlets. Depth index 34.
zones.826010: Reasonably supplied: 40 places for about 30,000 residents (index 64), 0 chain outlets.

restaurants.read: Restaurants & fast food are 5.1% of mapped places against 5.3% in Ranchi, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Domino's 8 (Ranchi 16), KFC 5 (Ranchi 5), Wow! Momo 3 (Ranchi 4), Pizza Hut 2 (Ranchi 6). No mapped outlet in either city: La Pino'z, Faasos.
restaurants.watch: Independent eateries are numerous and unevenly mapped. Treat the index as a screen and confirm competitor density street by street.

cafes.read: Cafés, tea & coffee are 1.7% of mapped places against 1.8% in Ranchi, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Café Coffee Day 3 (Ranchi 7), Chai Sutta Bar 1 (Ranchi 1), Chai Point 1 (Ranchi 0). No mapped outlet in either city: Starbucks, Chaayos, Blue Tokai.
cafes.watch: Chai stalls and independent cafés are under-mapped. A café concept here competes on price and habit as much as on novelty.

desserts.read: Desserts, sweets & ice cream are 0.4% of mapped places against 0.4% in Ranchi, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Baskin Robbins 2 (Ranchi 5). No mapped outlet in either city: Havmor, Naturals, Theobroma, Cream Stone.
desserts.watch: Traditional sweet shops are the real benchmark and sit outside most chain lists.

grocery.read: Grocery & daily needs are 1.3% of mapped places against 1.6% in Ranchi — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Smart / Fresh 5 (Ranchi 16), Big Bazaar 3 (Ranchi 1), Spencer's 2 (Ranchi 0), Vishal Mega Mart 1 (Ranchi 8). No mapped outlet in either city: More, Easyday, Star Bazaar.
grocery.watch: Neighbourhood kirana stores are the real incumbents and the least completely mapped outlets, so any gap is overstated. Test a site against local store density before acting.

pharmacy.read: Pharmacy & health retail are 2.2% of mapped places against 1.7% in Ranchi — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Apollo Pharmacy 6 (Ranchi 13). No mapped outlet in either city: MedPlus, Wellness Forever, Frank Ross.
pharmacy.watch: Independent chemists are dense and lightly mapped. Hospital and clinic clusters are the natural anchors.

apparel.read: Apparel, footwear & jewellery are 6.1% of mapped places against 5.0% in Ranchi — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: V-Mart 6 (Ranchi 6), Reliance Trends 4 (Ranchi 10), Raymond 4 (Ranchi 12), Bata 3 (Ranchi 12). No mapped outlet in either city: Zudio, Max Fashion, Lifestyle.
apparel.watch: Established multi-brand traders and local bazaars sit behind these numbers; new entrants compete with them as well as with chains.

banking.read: Banks & ATMs are 8.6% of mapped places against 7.7% in Ranchi — above its share.
banking.watch: This category includes insurance and agency offices, so it overstates branch banking. Use it as a signal of commercial activity, not a branch count.

coaching.read: Coaching & training are 4.1% of mapped places against 3.8% in Ranchi, so the mix is level.
coaching.watch: Coaching demand follows the exam calendar. Formats that depend on it should be tested across the academic year.

fitness.read: Fitness & wellness are 3.1% of mapped places against 4.6% in Ranchi — below its share.
fitness.watch: Gym listings change often and are inconsistently categorised; verify before drawing conclusions.
